description: Search current Arbeitnow job listings by keyword, category, tags, company or city, or paste specific Arbeitnow job URLs. No login, cookies or proxy needed.

category.description: Use one of Arbeitnow's own topic, city or collection pages, such as Python, Berlin, Remote, Visa sponsorship or English speaking. Choose 'Any' for no category filter.
category.title: Category or city

companies.description: Keep jobs from these companies. Accepts company names, company slugs or company page URLs, e.g. ["Zattoo", "https://www.arbeitnow.com/jobs/companies/n8n"]. Any match is kept.
companies.title: Companies

datePosted.description: Arbeitnow's feed holds roughly the last seven days of jobs. Choose a shorter window for fresher listings.
datePosted.title: Posted within

includeDetails.description: Open each selected job page to add the company logo, expiry date, employment type and curated benefits (visa sponsorship, relocation, English-friendly). Slower but richer.
includeDetails.sectionDescription: Optional enrichment from the job's detail page.
includeDetails.title: Fetch detail-page extras

jobTypes.description: Keep jobs whose employment labels contain any of these phrases, e.g. ["Full Time"], ["Internship"], ["Werkstudent"], ["Freelance"]. Leave empty for all types.
jobTypes.title: Job types

location.description: Keep jobs whose location text contains this phrase (case-insensitive), e.g. "Berlin", "Munich" or "Germany". Leave blank for any location.
location.title: Location contains

maxItems.description: Stop after this many matching jobs. The whole current feed is about 5,900 jobs; larger runs take longer and read more pages.
maxItems.sectionDescription: Cap the run so schedules stay predictable.
maxItems.title: Maximum jobs

mode.description: Choose how to find jobs. Search uses Arbeitnow's own search and filters; By URLs reads the exact listing pages you paste.
mode.sectionDescription: Use search for keywords and filters, or paste specific Arbeitnow job links.
mode.title: Mode

remote.description: Only return jobs that Arbeitnow flags as remote. Arbeitnow's flag is sparse; the Remote category also finds jobs whose location or title says remote.
remote.sectionDescription: Optional filters. Search mode applies them through Arbeitnow's search where possible, then verifies each row.
remote.title: Remote only

searchQuery.description: Keyword matched by Arbeitnow's search across job title, company and description (e.g. "python developer", "data engineer", "sales"). Leave blank to list all jobs matching the other filters.
searchQuery.title: Search query

sortBy.description: Newest returns the most recently posted jobs first. Relevance uses Arbeitnow's keyword ranking when a search query is set.
sortBy.title: Sort results

tags.description: Keep jobs carrying every tag listed here (case-insensitive), e.g. ["Software Development", "Remote"]. Tags are Arbeitnow's category/tech labels, not free-text keywords.
tags.title: Tags

urls.description: Used only in 'Scrape these job URLs' mode. Paste full Arbeitnow job links, e.g. https://www.arbeitnow.com/jobs/companies/zattoo/senior-backend-engineer-python-berlin-435689.
urls.title: Job URLs

title: Arbeitnow Job Listings Scraper Input
